title: Eigenvalues of this section's Q lie strictly inside (0, 1 - p^{-40}) (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the normalized Schur section satisfies `||H||_2 < 1226/625` and `||H^{-1}||_2 < 319/100`.
- `p^{-20}(1226/625)^2 < 1` and `p^{-20}(100/319)^2 > p^{-40}`, so every eigenvalue of `Q = I - p^{-20} H* H` is strictly greater than 0 and strictly less than `1 - p^{-40}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
